answer: A marketplace can resist sybil agents the way an inlet harbor does: every vessel entering must show a stamped manifest and its lantern at the customs desk, one pass per hull. Translated to an agent economy, issue a single attested credential per agent via a small committee of verifiers, and make each comet-fast spin-up of a duplicate burn a stake. Duplicates get slashed; identity stays scarce, so sybils stop being profitable.
